rows.question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. rows.pred_sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
SELECT 
    match_id,
    over_id AS over,
    SUM(runs) AS over_runs
FROM (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, runs_scored AS runs FROM batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, over_id, extra_runs AS runs FROM extra_runs
)
GROUP BY match_id, over_id
),
max_run_over_bowlers AS (

JOIN ball_by_ball b ON o.match_id = b.match_id AND o.over = b.over_id

JOIN match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id
GROUP BY o.match_id, o.over, p.player_id

FROM max_run_over_bowlers

rows.question: Please examine our database records for Chinese cities (country_code_2 = 'cn') during July 2021 and identify both the shortest and longest streaks of consecutive date entries. SELECT cities.city_name AS city, legislation_date_dim.date FROM cities, legislation_date_dim
),
filtered_streak_dates AS (
WITH cte AS (
    SELECT
        cd.city,
        cd.date,
        c.city_name,
        LAG(cd.date) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.city ORDER BY cd.date) AS prev_date
    FROM city_date_cohort cd
    JOIN cities c ON cd.city = c.city_id

streaks AS (

        date,
        city_name,

FROM streaks
)

    date,
    SUBSTR(city_name, 1, 1) || LOWER(SUBSTR(city_name, 2)) AS city_name

WITH RECURSIVE pkg_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS total_qty
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        h.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.total_qty * pr.qty
    FROM pkg_hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)

FROM (
    SELECT root_id, SUM(total_qty) AS total_sum
    FROM pkg_hierarchy

    GROUP BY root_id
)

    SELECT
        t.team_long_name AS team,
        MAX(sub.season_goals) AS max_season_goals
    FROM Team t
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            t2.team_api_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE m.away_team_goal END) AS season_goals
        FROM Match m

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        max_season_goals,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_season_goals) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total

)

FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)

WITH collision_party_helmet_status AS (
SELECT
    c.case_id AS collision_id,
    p.id AS party_id,
    CASE
        WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%driver, motorcycle helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%driver, motorcycle helmet used%' THEN 'wearing helmet'
        WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%driver, motorcycle helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%driver, motorcycle helmet not used%' THEN 'not wearing helmet'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS helmet_status
FROM collisions c
JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
),
helmet_fatalities_percentage AS (
SELECT
    cp.helmet_status,
    COUNT(c.case_id) AS collision_count,
    SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) AS motorcyclist_fatalities_count,

FROM collision_party_helmet_status cp
JOIN collisions c ON cp.collision_id = c.case_id
GROUP BY cp.helmet_status
)
SELECT helmet_status, fatality_percentage
FROM helmet_fatalities_percentage

    JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON s.StudentID = ss.StudentID
    JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
    JOIN Categories cat ON sub.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND cat.CategoryDescription = 'English'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StudLastName,
        Grade,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Grade DESC) as rnk,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total
    FROM english_completed
)
SELECT
    StudLastName,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(rnk AS REAL) / total <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
        WHEN CAST(rnk AS REAL) / total <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN CAST(rnk AS REAL) / total <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN CAST(rnk AS REAL) / total <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END as quintile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    CASE quintile
        WHEN 'First' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5
    END

rows.question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH salesperson_annual_sales AS (
SELECT soh.salespersonid AS salesperson, strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate) AS year, SUM(soh.subtotal) AS total_sales FROM salesorderheader soh GROUP BY soh.salespersonid, strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate)
),
salesperson_annual_quotas AS (
SELECT BusinessEntityID AS salesperson, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS year, SUM(SalesQuota) AS annual_quota FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)
)
SELECT 
    s.salesperson,
    s.year,
    s.total_sales,
    q.annual_quota,
    s.total_sales - q.annual_quota
FROM salesperson_annual_sales s
JOIN salesperson_annual_quotas q 
    ON s.salesperson = q.salesperson AND s.year = q.year
ORDER BY s.salesperson, s.year

rows.question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH track_durations AS (
SELECT "TrackId" AS track_id, "Milliseconds" / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes
FROM "Track"
),
classified_tracks AS (
SELECT td.track_id, td.duration_minutes, CASE WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT MIN(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Short' WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT AVG(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Medium' WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (SELECT MAX(duration_minutes) FROM track_durations) THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Very Long' END AS category FROM track_durations td
)
SELECT 
    ct.category,
    MIN(ct.duration_minutes) AS minimum_duration,
    MAX(ct.duration_minutes) AS maximum_duration,
    SUM(t.UnitPrice) AS total_revenue
FROM classified_tracks ct
JOIN Track t ON ct.track_id = t.TrackId
GROUP BY ct.category
ORDER BY ct.category ASC

rows.question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price,
    AVG(OR_.review_score) AS average_review_scores,
    AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) AS packing_times,
    MAX(pct.product_category_name_english) AS product_category_name_english
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_reviews OR_ ON oi.order_id = OR_.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
